logo.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a single final-quality ORIGINAL flat vector-friendly logo SYMBOL ONLY for FlakeMap, an agent workflow reliability brand. Transparent background. 1024 x 1024 canvas.
The attached approved website direction is reference material: refine the small folded-path emblem at its top-left into a distinctive polished production brand mark. It represents one workflow folding back to replay and revealing a split path. Preserve its compact folded-band character. Do not create a bird, feather, butterfly, snowflake, letter F, infinity sign, generic hexagon or AI network.
Symbol: two asymmetrical interlocking folded ribbons, one continuous visual route from lower left through a crisp central crossover to upper right, with a small second return route. Angular softened folded-sheet geometry, broad simple bands, central negative-space opening, compact diagonal silhouette. Exactly one mark, centered with generous transparent margins. Geometric, refined, legible at 16px, harmonious precise optical balance. Very few shapes, no intricate cuts.
MONOCHROME solid deep navy #171E33. All visible bands use the same solid color; negative space is fully transparent. Absolutely no gradients, shading, drop shadow, glow, outlines, texture, embossed 3D, perspective scene, glass, text, wordmark, swatches, presentation board, slogan, watermark or background. Transparent pixels around and inside symbol. Produce the flat master silhouette ready for vector tracing.
logo.vectorProduction: Alpha silhouette traced with VTracer; paths flattened to brand ink. Original source retained. Manrope 800 wordmark converted to outlines using FontTools.

backgrounds.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL production website BACKGROUND ART asset for FlakeMap's selected Prism Replay identity. Landscape 1920 x 1080. The attached selected website mockup is inspiration for the original folded trace ribbon's material and light; create a clean background asset, not a website screenshot. NO TEXT, letters, numbers, labels, logo, UI, diagrams, cards, birds, feathers, robots, orb, particles or watermark.
Pearl white mist environment, subtly icy floor plane, beautifully authored translucent glass-like folded strip indicating a single agent workflow route. One continuous broad thin ribbon travels from lower left through lower middle to upper right, with tasteful physical refraction and restrained pale ice/sage highlights. The route has a small folded-back section suggesting replay, but not an infinity symbol. Elegant thin silhouette, real optical folds, very slight grain; premium editorial infrastructure aesthetic. No mountain ranges, no generic 3D tech islands, no geometric platforms.
Composition critical: upper left 55% and upper middle leave bright empty neutral negative space for large dark typography. Put the main object largely in lower 45% with one small lifted end at far right; leave navigation space at top. Luminosity gentle, no harsh glare or saturated rainbow. Colors #F7F8FA #EEF2F7 #DCE7EE #E1EBE6; dark ink is for future text, not baked into artwork. The scene should imply a persistent route through a story, not decorative abstract chaos. Output one full bleed high quality background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create original wide 1920 x 1080 BACKGROUND ART for FlakeMap's chosen Prism Replay brand. NO text, letters, labels, logo, UI, bird, feather, character, robot, orb, stars, watermark or copied imagery. The attached approved visual is material inspiration only.
This is the ICE FAULT CHAMBER background, different composition from a broad hero ribbon. Macro close-up of a translucent broad thin route strip in a pale ice-white studio: at a sharply defined central fault seam, ONE incoming strip from the left becomes TWO separate thin folded outgoing strips on the right, separated by a clean gap so the diverging routes are visibly different. The seam has a tiny restrained copper glint, no explosive glow. Thin glass-sheet edges, subtle frosted regions and physics-respecting refraction. Very quiet elegant internal pale sage/prism tones. Foreground depth at lower right, empty upper third for titles. Camera more top-down, flatter, diagnostic and close than the hero horizon. Light matte plane with fine hairline shadow; no mountain background or decorative crystals. Primary #EEF2F7 #DCE7EE #F7F8FA, small #A6502A glint. No intense rainbow. This background will support labeled overlays in a future animated fault/retry chapter; do not bake diagrams or labels into art. One coherent scene with readable negative space, premium restrained aesthetic.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ORIGINAL production background art for FlakeMap Prism Replay, landscape 1920 x 1080. This is a MIDNIGHT DIAGNOSTICS chapter background. The attached selected website is only the material direction; create a distinctly darker diagnostic scene of the same folded trace material. NO UI, text, labels, logos, graphs, people, birds, feathers, robots, orb, stars, particles, neon, generic network nodes or watermark.
Deep midnight ink #171E33 matte field, subtly darker #10172A at edges. A thin softly frosted pale-glass workflow ribbon enters lower left, folds upward along the far left edge and returns across the lower third. It is a quiet architectural object, with visible shallow sheet edges and controlled glints, not a bright glowing ring or infinity loop. Gentle steel/sage light, restrained very small copper seam detail. Main object stays on lower/left quarter so right 65% and upper half are calm dark empty space for cream text and an opaque light workbench overlay. No mountain or landscape, no noisy texture. Studio material study, deliberately quiet low key lighting, precise polished folds, premium editorial tone. Dark background must remain uniform enough for consistent text contrast. One full-bleed original background that can introduce an important evidence/diagnostic decision.
